dslRule:
<!id: multicatch.identical.blocks>
<!description: Combines two consecutive catch blocks with identical bodies and exception variable names into a single multi-catch block (Java 7+).>
<!severity: HINT>
try {
    $tryStatements$;
} catch ($Type1 $e$) {
    $catchStatements$;
} catch ($Type2 $e$) {
    $catchStatements$;
}
=>
try {
    $tryStatements$;
} catch ($Type1 | $Type2 $e$) {
    $catchStatements$;
}
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
